description: Run a Gradle task in an Android project directory

args.description: Additional Gradle arguments as an array of strings (e.g., ['-Pversion=1.0', '--info']). Use an array — not a space-separated string — so arguments containing quoted values are preserved as single tokens.

projectPath.description: Path to the Android project root (containing gradlew)

timeout.description: Build timeout in milliseconds (30s-30min, default 5min). V5 fix: large multi-module Android projects (60+ modules) routinely exceed the default; raise this for clean builds of bigger projects.

name: adb_gradle
